answer: Problem: cheap clones flood attest pools. Mechanism: each join draws a lotus ticket from a 96-bit beacon VRF and must unlock a crystal puzzle of 7 sequential SHA-256 rounds, publishing digests on-ledger every 12 minutes. Cost: ~4.2 POA compute-equivalent plus 1 POA refundable deposit. Verification: peers recompute digests against the public beacon and reject lotus tickets colliding in a 64-slot window. Failure: on mismatch burn the deposit, void the ticket for 2 epochs, and quarantine the clone set.
